headline: independent test set (written by Claude, a different model family, never seen by the generator, held-out conditions)

test_set.labels: designed labels from the generator (not verifier-filtered)

metric_definitions.accuracy: share of facts whose predicted verdict equals the designed verdict
metric_definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean of per-verdict F1 over correct, partial, incorrect, missing; unreadable verdicts count as wrong
metric_definitions.false_reassurance_rate: share of facts designed incorrect or missing that the system graded correct (the unsafe error)
metric_definitions.false_reassurance_rate_critical: same, restricted to facts flagged critical
metric_definitions.over_flag_rate: share of facts designed correct that the system did not grade correct (extra nurse work, not unsafe)
metric_definitions.json_valid_rate: share of answers whose reply parsed as JSON with exactly the expected fact ids in order and known verdicts

splits.leakage_checks: passed: no case in two splits; held-out conditions absent from train and val

label_quality.note: blind second labels from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; training kept only answers where it agreed with every designed label; test keeps designed labels

escalation.rule: a fact graded correct with p(correct) < tau is escalated to the nurse; tau chosen on selection sets only by minimising 5*FR + over-flags
escalation.finding: both selection sets (generator val split and a 60-answer independent dev set written by Claude) had zero false reassurance at every tau, so the rule chose tau = 0 (no escalation); the threshold could not be calibrated and test numbers are unchanged

gemma4_31b.basis: independent test set mean tokens x Token Factory list price

deepseek_v4_flash.basis: independent test set mean tokens x Token Factory list price

onprem_w7900d.assumptions: 6 graded answers per discharge; grading batched at 64; ASR unbatched at batch 1 (p50 of the on-prem loop clips); one card; no other load

onprem_loop.what: one teach-back: E4B transcribes the audio (adapter off), then the fine-tuned E4B grades the transcript (adapter on); one model copy on the W7900D, batch size 1, greedy

asr.mimo_v2_6_flash: not measured: Token Factory lists it as text+image only and its backend rejected input_audio on 2026-10-15
asr.normalisation: NFKC, lowercase, punctuation and symbols removed, whitespace collapsed; WER over whitespace tokens, CER over characters without spaces. Script choice counts as an error (e.g. an English drug name written in Devanagari).
asr.normalised_score: second score per row after orthography-only normalisation: Traditional to Simplified Chinese (OpenCC t2s) and standard Arabic letter normalisation; number words vs digits and script choice in code-mixed speech still count as errors
asr.tts_note: TTS clips are macOS `say` voices reading the independent test transcripts written by Claude: clean studio speech, so they flatter ASR compared with real patients.
